authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full śukra entry has an unnumbered -l- extension with Prakrit sukkila/sukkilla white, Jaunsari śuklō/śuklo, Kotgarhi śúklɔ and Kumaoni/Nepali sukilo white/shining. These directly support the selected Dotyali and Jaunsari responses. The existing extension node 12506-3 is used with base-entry citation because it is not printed subsection 3. Source sibilants, laterals and vowels remain intact; local transmission is qualified. Exact response: śukilo.
